claims.claim: description: "Test adaptability: the software runs on each supported OS, runtime, database, container platform and configuration without changes beyond documented configuration."
claims.note: Scope summary: the only listed source 500s today, so no listed page could be read; the working CTAL-TTA page and syllabus PDF (neither listed) name no OS/runtime/database/container dimensions - the syllabus only says adaptability testing 'checks whether a given application can function correctly in all intended target environments (hardware, software, middleware, operating system, etc.)'.

claims.claim: the product works in every supported environment. CTAL-TTA v4.0 4.6.
claims.note: The listed source 500s today; the working CTAL-TTA page shows topic titles with no section numbers; the ISTQB CTAL-TTA v4.0 syllabus PDF (not a listed source) numbers 4.6 as Maintainability Testing and adaptability testing as 4.7.3 under 4.7 Portability Testing, so the 4.6 reference looks off-by-one, but no readable listed source covers it.
